android.title: My Talking Tom 2: Pet Game
android.summary: Offline pet game: care for virtual cat Tom, play mini-games, explore worlds.
android.description:
My Talking Tom 2 is a virtual pet game where you care for Tom, play offline mini-games, and explore fun worlds. Feed him, customise his look, collect pets, and enjoy his iconic talk-back reactions.

🛁 Virtual Pet Care 
Look after Tom by feeding him, making sure he gets enough sleep, and keeping him happy. Watch him react to what you do — he’ll repeat what you say in his funny voice, laugh at your jokes, and show expressive emotions. 

Help with daily routines like brushing teeth, bathing, and bathroom visits, then jump back into play whenever you like.

✈️ Explore Worlds by Plane 
Fly Tom’s plane to visit colourful destinations, each with surprises and collectibles: 
✓ Candy Kingdom
✓ Pirate Island
✓ Underwater Home
✓ Adventure Beach
✓ Magic Forest
✓ Cyber City
✓ Dragon Kingdom
✓ Alien Planet

 🎮 Offline Mini-Games 
Play offline mini-games to earn coins and unlock rewards: 
✓ Space Trails
✓ Sky Race
✓ Dunk-a-Pet
✓ Build Your Plane

🎨 Customisation and Home Decoration 
Choose from hundreds of outfits and fun styles, change Tom’s look, and decorate his home with items you unlock as you play. 

🐾 Pets and Skills 
Tom has pet companions that join your adventures. Care for them, play together, and watch their interactions.
Teach Tom new skills like playing drums, shooting hoops, and boxing to unlock fresh animations and moments. 

💬 Talk-Back Reactions 
Tom’s iconic feature returns — he repeats what you say and reacts when you poke or chat to him, keeping every visit lively. 

✅ Play Anywhere 
No Wi-Fi? No problem. Play offline after installation — great for travel and on-the-go sessions. 

Technical Information 
Free to download with optional in-app purchases. Progress saves automatically. Regular updates add seasonal content, outfits, and events. Supports multiple languages, including English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Russian, Turkish, and Arabic.

ios.description:
The superstar virtual cat is going on the ultimate pet adventure, and with you, it's going to be more fun than ever! Your favorite funny friend is ready to dazzle you with his new wardrobe, amazing skills, and special features.

What You Can Do:

- Learn New Skills: Teach Tom cool tricks and skills like playing drums, basketball, and boxing. He'll be the most talented cat around!

- Taste the Latest Snacks: Discover and feed Tom various delicious and funny snacks. From ice cream to sushi, Tom loves it all! Do you dare to give him a hot chili pepper?

- Stay Clean: Help Tom stay fresh and clean with fun activities like bathing and brushing his teeth. Keep him squeaky clean!

- Pop to the Toilet: Yes, even Tom needs bathroom breaks, and it's as funny as it sounds! Help him out and make sure he's comfy.

- Explore New Worlds: Travel with Tom to exciting new places and discover hidden surprises. Fly to different islands with special flight tokens!

- Collect Clothes, Furniture, and Special Memories: Customize Tom's look with crazy outfits and decorate his home with funky furniture.

- Gacha Goodies: Unlock awesome rewards and surprises by doing different activities. Get cool outfits, delicious snacks, and more!


Extra Fun Activities:

- Play on Giant Swing and Trampoline: Let Tom swing high and jump around for some extra laughs.

- Cook Smoothies: Blend up delicious and wacky smoothies for Tom to enjoy.

- Heal Booboos: Take care of Tom when he gets hurt and make sure he's back to his playful self in no time.

- Mini Games and Puzzles: Challenge yourself with entertaining mini-games and puzzles that keep you hooked for hours.

- Keep Playing: See how Talking Tom's backyard changes into a Candy Kingdom, Pirate Island, Underwater Home, and other magical worlds, where you can dive into the endless fun with Tom and his pet friends.

This virtual pet game is packed with adventure, laughter, and unforgettable moments! Make sure you capture them all!

The game is cool and a lot better than My Talking Tom, except for in terms of clothes, accessories and decorations. Wish there were more selection in these categories. The mini games are also cooler. Except for the controls in Space Trail. They're extremely wonky and the snake is hard to control. I also don't like getting duplicate cards. So to recap: More clothes, accessories, decorations, get rid of the chances of getting duplicates, and fix the controls in Space Trail, and I'll rate higher. Also, the game keeps crashing and freezing to the point were I have to exit out.

It's a good game for the most part. But there should be more variety of mini games, even the ones from the original My Talking Tom would do. The mini games are bland in my opinion. I like the concept of Tom having his own pet, but each of them should have a different voice. I like the idea of using a plane to get gifts, but getting coins and stars can be difficult. I would recommend adding coins to mini games with the plane fuel. There should also be a larger variety of clothing for Tom.
